## About
Affordable Muffler LLC is a locally owned auto repair shop on Dairy Ashford Rd in Houston's Energy Corridor. We work on mufflers, brakes, shocks and catalytic converters, and we try to get you back on the road quickly.
Customers tell us they like the old school feel of the place. Manuel, the owner, often greets you himself, and our welders handle custom exhaust setups, including aftermarket mufflers you bring in yourself. We carry brands like MagnaFlow, Borla and FlowMaster.
We keep things honest and friendly, with high-end parts at prices that won't break the bank. While you wait, there's free Wi-Fi and coffee.

## Services
- Mufflers: Muffler repair and replacement, plus custom exhaust work and installing aftermarket mufflers.
- Brakes: Brake inspections and repairs using premium parts to keep your braking system working the way it should.
- Shocks: Shock replacement for better handling and a smoother, more stable ride.
- Catalytic converters: Catalytic converter replacement, backed by a two-year warranty.

## FAQ
Q: What warranty do you offer?
A: We offer a one-year warranty on all parts and labor, plus a two-year warranty on catalytic converters.

Q: How soon can you look at my car?
A: We're usually available within the hour, so you can just stop by.

Q: Can I bring my own muffler?
A: Yes. Customers have brought in parts they bought online, and we welded them in.

Q: How can I pay?
A: We take cash or Cash App. We don't take cards.

Q: Do you work with insurance?
A: Yes, we work with insurance.

Q: Is there a discount for first responders, teachers or veterans?
A: Yes. We offer a 20% discount for first responders, law enforcement, teachers and veterans.
